117 static void mboxRemoteMailboxCallbackFxn (RPMessage_Object *obj,
118  void *arg, void *data, uint16_t dataLen, int32_t crcStatus,
119  uint16_t remoteCoreId, uint16_t remoteEndPt)
120 {
121  gCbHitCnt++;
122  /* This is assumed that only a single core will generate the interrupt at a time. */
123  /* Scenarios when callbackFxn is hit, before data is consumed are not taken care.
124  * and data is subject to get overwritten with the new data. */
125  gDPMObj.dpmInitCfg.reportFxn((void*)data, dataLen);
126 }

149 DPM_Handle DPM_init(DPM_InitCfg* ptrInitCfg, int32_t* errCode)
150 {
151  DPM_MCB* ptrDPM = NULL;
152  RPMessage_CreateParams createParams;
153 
154  /* Sanity Check */
155  if((ptrInitCfg == NULL) || (errCode == NULL))
156  {
157  return NULL;
158  }
159 
160  RPMessage_CreateParams_init(&createParams);
161  createParams.localEndPt = ptrInitCfg->localEndPt;
162  /* Setup IPC callback configuration: */
163  createParams.recvCallback = mboxRemoteMailboxCallbackFxn;
164 
165  /* Initialize the DPM Master control block: */
166  ptrDPM = (DPM_MCB*)&gDPMObj;
167  (void)memset ((void*)ptrDPM, 0, sizeof(DPM_MCB));
168 
169  (void)memcpy ((void*)&ptrDPM->dpmInitCfg, (void*)ptrInitCfg, sizeof(DPM_InitCfg));
170 
171  *errCode = RPMessage_construct(&ptrDPM->ipcMailboxObj, &createParams);
172 
173  *errCode = Mmw_setLinkState(ptrInitCfg->setBitPos, (uint8_t)1U);
174 
175  return (DPM_Handle)ptrDPM;
176 }

178 /* mmw_synch all cores */
179 int32_t DPM_synch(DPM_Handle handle, int32_t* errCode)
180 {
181  *errCode = SystemP_SUCCESS;
182  CSL_mss_ctrlRegs *mssCtrl = CSL_MSS_CTRL_getBaseAddress();
183  int32_t retVal = SystemP_FAILURE;
184  uint32_t status;
185 
186  /* check if other cores are enable */
187  if (mssCtrl != NULL)
188  {
189  /* Get the operational status for the CM4 */
190  status = CSL_FEXTR (mssCtrl->MSS_BOOT_INFO_REG0, 2U, 0U);
191  retVal = (int32_t) status;
192  }
193  return retVal;
194 }

196 int32_t DPM_send(DPM_Handle handle, void* arg, uint32_t argLen, uint16_t remoteCoreID)
197 {
198  int32_t retVal;
199  DPM_MCB* ptrDPM;
200 
201  ptrDPM = (DPM_MCB*)handle;
202  if (ptrDPM == NULL)
203  {
204  /* Error: Invalid argument */
205  retVal = DPM_EINVAL;
206  return retVal;
207  }
208 
209  retVal = RPMessage_send((void *)arg, (uint16_t)argLen, remoteCoreID,
210  gRemoteCoreEndPt[remoteCoreID], ptrDPM->dpmInitCfg.localEndPt,
211  SystemP_WAIT_FOREVER);
212 
213  return retVal;
214 }
